Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000934, which was taken on 2015-10-30. The amount in dispute is $240.63. According to our records, the correct spoils allowance for this store and period is $211.08 (0.0100 of $21,108.24 invoiced). Therefore, the amount to repay is $29.55. The dispute deadline was 2016-04-27, and this deadline has passed.

We hope to resolve this matter promptly. Please contact us at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,

Northfield Pantry Co.
